e.title: **把官方公布的 PDF 与电子表格变成可计算的结构，并把这条箭头写出来**：一个处理美国国税局精算因子表的工具集**逐字给出整条链**——**「**90CM：PDF → 提取脚本 → CSV → Python → JSON；**2010CM 与根表：官方 XLSX／XLS → Python → JSON；**再由 C# 应用 → Excel／文本／SQL Server，**或**因子场景／网页界面 → 答案」**；**其 PDF 提取逐字说明「**用脚本化的 `pdfplumber` 提取器**，并**逐值对照 2016 年的 Tabula 参考 CSV 核验**」**
e.title_en: Turning officially published PDFs and spreadsheets into something computable, and writing that arrow out: a toolset for United States internal revenue actuarial factor tables states the whole chain verbatim, PDF through an extraction script to CSV to JSON, official spreadsheets straight to JSON, and then an application out to spreadsheets, text, a database, or factor scenarios and a web interface for answers, with the PDF extraction stated verbatim to be done by a scripted extractor and verified value by value against a reference set of tables from another tool
e.title_hk: **把官方公布的 PDF 與電子表格變成可計算的結構，並把這條箭頭寫出來**：一個處理美國國稅局精算因子表的工具集**逐字給出整條鏈**——**「**90CM：PDF → 提取腳本 → CSV → Python → JSON；**2010CM 與根表：官方 XLSX／XLS → Python → JSON；**再由 C# 應用 → Excel／文本／SQL Server，**或**因子場景／網頁界面 → 答案」**；**其 PDF 提取逐字說明「**用腳本化的 `pdfplumber` 提取器**，並**逐值對照 2016 年的 Tabula 參考 CSV 核驗**」**
e.summary: 一个**处理美国国税局精算因子表（出版物 1457／1458／1459）的工具集**（★1、**C#**、仓库体量 **82 MB**、**最后推送落在窗口之内**）：**逐字自述所处理的来源为**「**美国国税局公布的**精算因子数据」**，**而**整条链被写成一行箭头**——**逐字「**90CM：PDF → `Extract90CMFromPdf.py` → CSV → Python → JSON；**2010CM 与根表：官方 XLSX／XLS → Python → JSON；**再由 C# 应用 → Excel／文本／SQL Server，**或**因子场景／网页界面 → 答案」**；**其最值得记的一处是**来源与来源核对****——**逐字说明 90CM 系列是**「**用脚本化的 `pdfplumber` 提取器从 PDF 中提取的，**并**逐值对照 2016 年的 Tabula 参考 CSV 核验**」**，**而**2010CM 与根表**「**直接由官方 XLSX／XLS 电子表格转换**」**；**第二处是它**说明提取出来的 CSV **可以从 PDF 重新生成****；**第三处是它**把「答案」建在**已提交的数据**上**（**逐字说明因子命令与网页界面**从已提交的数据计算场景**：**终身财产、**剩余权益、**年金与 **CRUT／CRAT** 因子，**并逐字注明是「**精确的公布网格查表」**）
e.summary_hk: 一個**處理美國國稅局精算因子表（出版物 1457／1458／1459）的工具集**（★1、**C#**、體量 **82 MB**、**最後推送落在窗口之內**）：**逐字自述所處理的來源為**「**美國國稅局公布的精算因子數據」**，而**整條鏈被寫成一行箭頭**——**逐字「**90CM：PDF → `Extract90CMFromPdf.py` → CSV → Python → JSON；**2010CM 與根表：官方 XLSX／XLS → Python → JSON；**再由 C# 應用 → Excel／文本／SQL Server，**或**因子場景／網頁界面 → 答案」**；**其最值得記的一處是**來源與來源核對****——**逐字說明 90CM 系列是**「**用腳本化的 `pdfplumber` 提取器從 PDF 中提取的，並逐值對照 2016 年的 Tabula 參考 CSV 核驗**」**，而 2010CM 與根表「**直接由官方 XLSX／XLS 電子表格轉換**」；**第二處是它**說明提取出來的 CSV 可以從 PDF 重新生成****；**第三處是它**把「答案」建在**已提交的數據**上**（**逐字說明因子命令與網頁界面**從已提交的數據計算場景**：**終身財產、**剩餘權益、**年金與 **CRUT／CRAT** 因子，並逐字註明是「**精確的公布網格查表」**）
e.summary_en: A toolset for the actuarial factor tables published by the United States internal revenue service, under a named set of publications — 1 star, C#, an 82 MB repository, last pushed inside the window — describing the data it processes verbatim as actuarial factor data published by that authority and writing the whole chain as one arrow: from PDF through an extraction script to CSV to JSON for one series, from official spreadsheets straight to JSON for another, and then out through an application to spreadsheets, text or a database, or through factor scenarios and a web interface to answers. **Its most notable feature is the source and the checking of that source**: the PDF series is stated verbatim to be extracted by a scripted extractor **and verified value by value against a reference set of comma-separated tables from another tool**, while the other series is stated verbatim to be converted directly from official spreadsheets. **The second is that the extracted tables are stated to be regenerable from the PDFs.** **The third is that its answers are built on the committed data**, the factor command and the web interface computing scenarios from it for life estates, remainders, annuities and charitable remainder trust factors, described verbatim as exact published-grid lookups.
e.body:
**irs-actuarial-tables-processor**（仓库 `Digiman/ActuarialFactors1990Processor`）**是一个处理美国国税局精算因子表的工具集**：**逐字自述为**「**Utilities that process actuarial factor data published by the IRS（Publications 1457/1458/1459）**」**。**实测 **★1**、fork 0、许可字段为 **NONE****（**⚠️ 三重信号一致，见下**）、主语言 **C#**、仓库体量 **82,025 KB**、**创建 2022-04-13**、最后推送 **2026-09-09****（**均 GitHub API 实测值；**⭐ 创建远早于解冻窗口**，**推送落在窗口之内****）；**实测其**文档文件名为 `Readme.md`**（**⭐ 首字母大写、其余小写**——**⚠️ 本词条**据此指出：**按 `README.md` 惯例探测会漏掉它**），**仓库实测共 **239 个文件**，**其中含 `Docs/ActuarialTables-Research.md`、`Docs/Plan.md`、`JSONFiles/README.md`、`.github/workflows/ci.yml`，**以及 `DataFiles/2000CM/` 下多份官方表格（**`table-2000cm.xls`、`table-c-2000cm.xls`、`table-h-2000cm.xls`、`table-r2-2009.xlsx`、`table-s-2000cm.xlsx`、`table-u1-2000cm.xls`、`table-u2-2009cm.xlsx`、`table-z-2000cm.xls`**）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「源与生成物」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是本轮四条里**把「源 → 产物」这条链写得最直白的一条****。

可核实信息（**均 `Readme.md` 与 tree 实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 它把整条链写成**一行箭头**，并区分了**两种来源****——**逐字为**：**「**90CM: **PDF -> Extract90CMFromPdf.py -> CSV -> Python -> JSON**; **2010CM and root tables: official XLSX/XLS -> Python -> JSON**; then **C# app -> Excel / text / SQL Server**, or **factor scenarios / web UI -> answers**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **一行读完整个系统**（**⭐ 即**读者**不需要读代码**就知道**数据从哪来、经过谁、变成什么****）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **两种来源被分开**（**一个系列的源是 **PDF**，**另一个系列的源是**官方电子表格**）**——**⭐ 即**同一条链上**不是所有源都一样**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **下游有三种去向**（**Excel／文本／SQL Server**）**，**外加**两条「算答案」的去向**（**因子场景／网页界面**）**——**⭐ 即**「生成物」在这里**不止一种**；**④ ⭐⭐ **它把「答案」写成链的终点**（**逐字 `-> answers`**）**——**⭐ 即**它承认**整条链是为了**回答问题**。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **它说明了**源是怎么被核对过的****——**逐字为**：**「**the 90CM-series source tables are **extracted from the PDF files with a scripted `pdfplumber` extractor**, **verified value-by-value against the 2016 Tabula reference CSVs**; the 2010CM series and the root（non-mortality）tables are **converted directly from the official IRS XLSX/XLS spreadsheets**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「逐值对照另一套工具产出的参考表」**——**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮主题**最实在的一处**：**从 PDF 里抠数**这件事的**可信度**被**另一个来源**兜住了**（**⭐ 与第 348 轮 [[ducklm-sql-glm]] 的「与 statsmodels／scikit-learn 对到机器精度」同族**，**但这里的参照物**是另一套**PDF 取数工具**的输出**）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **提取器被具名**（**逐字 `pdfplumber`**）**——**⭐ 即**「用什么抠的」**可被复核****；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **「直接转换」与「提取」被区分**（**2010CM 与根表**不经过 PDF）**——**⭐ 即**它**只在对的源上用对的方法****；**④ ⭐⭐ **根表被注明是**非死亡率表**（**逐字 `(non-mortality)`**）**——**⭐ 即**表的两类**被区分**。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **它说明提取物**可以从源重新生成****——**逐字为**：**「**`DataFiles/90CM/` — **extracted CSV files (90CM series, regenerable from the PDFs)**」**⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐ **「可从 PDF 重新生成」**是**一条可检验的性质****（**⭐ 即**CSV**不是唯一副本**）；**② ⭐⭐ **数据被**分目录存放**（**`DataFiles/` 是源，**`JSONFiles/` 是处理后，**`XMLFiles/` 是生成物**）**——**⭐ 即**目录名**本身就表达了**链条上的位置****；**③ ⭐⭐ **XML 被逐字注明**不入版本库、需运行脚本生成**（**⭐ 即**哪一步的产物入库、**哪一步的产物**按需生成**被写清**）。**④ ⭐⭐ **它把「答案」建立在一份**精确查表**上，且用途逐条列出**——**逐字为**：**「**the `factor` command and the web UI **compute valuation scenarios from the committed data**: **life estates, remainders, annuities and CRUT/CRAT factors**（**IRS Publications 1457/1458/1459 semantics, exact published-grid lookups**）」**⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐ **四种计算对象逐条点名**（**终身财产／**剩余权益／**年金／**两类慈善剩余信托因子**）；**② ⭐⭐ **「精确的公布网格查表」是**一个可核对的实现选择****（**⭐ 即**它没有用插值**，**而是**查官方网格**）；**③ ⭐⭐ **「语义」被归给出版物**（**⭐ 即**计算规则的出处**是**官方出版物**）**。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **其余可核实细节**：**① **工程分层逐行列出**（**`DataProcessingApp.Core` 行类型与配置、**`.Logic` 通用装载／保存、**`.Data` SQL Server 批量插入、**`.Calculator` 场景计算、**`.ConsoleApp` 命令、**`.WebApi` 网页界面与 JSON 接口，**另有 `PythonDataApp`**）**；**② **测试分两套**（**C# 用 xUnit、**Python 用 pytest**）**，**而**SQL Server 集成测试**逐字注明「**CI 总是运行它们**」**、**本地则需要 Docker**（**⭐ 即**依赖被分级**）；**③ **依赖版本逐条给出**（**.NET SDK 10.0、**Python 3 与 `numpy`／`openpyxl`／`xlrd`／`pdfplumber`**）**；**④ **构建与测试命令逐条给出**（**`dotnet build`、**`dotnet test`、**`python -m pytest`**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ 可与本站条目并读**：[[mortsoa]]、[[mortalitytables]]、[[human-mortality-db]]、[[soa-practice-tools]]、[[ifoa-formulae-tables]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️ **三重信号一致指向**没有许可声明****：**GitHub 许可字段为 **NONE****、**实测默认分支 `main` 的根目录 `LICENSE` 与 `LICENSE.md` 均不存在**（**raw 探测均为 HTTP 404**）、**且实测其 `Readme.md` 全文以「licen／copyright／©」检索**零命中****——**⭐ 本词条指出这一处尤其要紧：**该仓库**把 IRS 公布的表格一并放进版本库**（**`DataFiles/` 下多份官方 XLS／XLSX**）**——**⭐ 即**代码的权利与**其中官方文件的再分发条件**是两件事**（**⚠️ 本词条**未查任何官方条款**）。**② ⚠️⚠️⚠️ **本次**没有运行它的任何一步****——**未安装 .NET SDK 或 Python 依赖、未跑 `dotnet build`／`dotnet test`／`pytest`、未运行任何提取脚本、未重生成任何 CSV／JSON／XML、未运行其因子命令或网页界面、未打开其任何官方表格文件**；**故**本词条**不主张**其提取、核验、转换或因子计算**按其所述工作**——**⭐ 本词条核实到的是**其 `Readme.md` 的**逐字内容**、**其经 tree 接口实测的文件清单与目录结构**、**以及**官方表格文件的**存在与名称**。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未读其任何源码或 `Docs/` 下的两份笔记****（**⭐ 即**未核对**「逐值对照」是如何实现的、**查表是否确实精确、**以及**CI 是否确实总是运行 SQL Server 集成测试**）**——**⭐ 这是本条目**最需要后续核实的一处**。**④ ⭐ ⚠️ **一处**命名**如实记录**：**其说明文件名为 `Readme.md`**（**⭐ 本词条**据此指出**按惯例探测会漏掉它**，**⚠️ 并**不据此评价其内容**）。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其提取结果与官方 PDF 是否一致**（**⭐ 即**那条「逐值核验」**只有其自述，**本词条未复核**）。**⑥ ⭐ ⚠️ **不主张**其因子可用于任何实际申报或估值**（**⭐ 计算规则的出处是官方出版物，**而**本词条**未核对任何一条规则**）。**⑦ ⚠️ **创建于 2022-04-13**，**最后推送 2026-09-09****——**⭐ 入选依据是**推送落在窗口之内**。**⑧ ⚠️ **本条目所记为**2026-09-11 所见****。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/Digiman/ActuarialFactors1990Processor` 于 2026-09-11 经仓库检索接口与 GitHub API 实测读取（★数、许可字段 NONE、语言、体量、创建／推送时间）；**其说明文件 `Readme.md` 经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测逐字核对**（**⚠️ 文件名首字母大写**）；根目录 `LICENSE` 与 `LICENSE.md` 的存在经 raw 探测确认（均为 HTTP 404）；**文件清单经 GitHub API tree 接口实测（239 个文件），据其核对 `src/`、`tests/`、`db/`、`DataFiles/`、`JSONFiles/`、`XMLFiles/`、`Docs/` 与 `.github/workflows/ci.yml` 的存在及 `DataFiles/2000CM/` 下官方表格的文件名**；**未克隆、未安装任何依赖、未运行任何脚本或测试、未重生成任何文件、未打开任何表格或 PDF、未做其他网络观察**。

**irs-actuarial-tables-processor** (repository `Digiman/ActuarialFactors1990Processor`) **is a toolset that processes the actuarial factor tables published by the United States internal revenue service**, describing itself verbatim as utilities that process actuarial factor data published by that authority under a named set of publications. **Measured 1 star, 0 forks, a licence field of NONE** — ⚠️ three signals agreeing, as set out below — **primary language C#, an 82,025 KB repository, created 2022-04-13 and last pushed 2026-09-09** (all GitHub API measurements; ⭐ **creation far predates the thaw window while the push falls inside it**); **its documentation file measurably has a mixed-case name rather than the usual all-capitals one**, ⚠️ **which this entry notes means probing for the conventional name misses it**; **the repository measures 239 files**, including two documents under a documentation directory, a readme inside the processed-data directory, a continuous-integration workflow, **and several official spreadsheets under a source-data directory named for one of the table series, including tables for the several factor types and two later reference years**. This entry belongs to this round’s theme of **source and generated artefact**, and ⭐⭐⭐ **of the four it writes the chain from source to product most plainly**.

Verifiable details (**read from its documentation file and measured in the tree**): ⭐⭐⭐ **① It writes the whole chain as one arrow and separates two kinds of source** — verbatim, one series goes from PDF through a named extraction script to CSV to JSON, **another series and the root tables go from official spreadsheets straight to JSON**, and then an application goes out to spreadsheets, text or a database, **or factor scenarios and a web interface go to answers** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **the whole system reads in one line, so a reader knows where the data come from, what they pass through and what they become without reading code**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the two kinds of source are kept apart, one series starting from a PDF and another from official spreadsheets**, ⭐ **so not every source on one chain is the same kind of source**; ⭐⭐⭐ **there are three downstream destinations plus two routes that compute answers**, ⭐ **so the artefact here is not a single thing**; **and ⭐⭐ answers are written as the end of the chain**, ⭐ **the whole chain existing in order to answer questions**. **② ⭐⭐⭐ It states how the source was checked** — verbatim, the first series is extracted from the PDFs with a scripted extractor **and verified value by value against a reference set of tables from another tool**, **while the second series and the root tables are converted directly from the official spreadsheets** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **verifying value by value against another tool’s output is the most substantial item in this round’s theme, since the credibility of pulling numbers out of a PDF is backed by a second source**, ⭐ **the same family as the library aligned against two reference implementations to machine precision, though the reference here is another PDF extraction tool’s output**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the extractor is named, so what did the pulling can be re-examined**; ⭐⭐⭐ **direct conversion and extraction are distinguished**, ⭐ **the right method being used on the right kind of source**; **and ⭐⭐ the root tables are marked as non-mortality**, ⭐ **so the two classes of table are distinguished**. **③ ⭐⭐⭐ It states that the extracted material can be regenerated from the source** — verbatim, the extracted comma-separated files are regenerable from the PDFs ⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐ **regenerable from the PDFs is a checkable property, so the extracted files are not the only copy**; ⭐⭐ **data are split across directories by position in the chain**, the source files in one, processed files in another and generated files in a third, ⭐ **so the directory names themselves express where a file sits on the chain**; **and ⭐⭐ one generated format is stated verbatim not to be committed and to require a script.** **④ ⭐⭐ It builds its answers on exact table lookups and lists the uses one by one** — verbatim, the factor command and the web interface compute valuation scenarios from the committed data, **covering life estates, remainders, annuities and charitable remainder trust factors, under the semantics of the named publications and using exact published-grid lookups** ⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐ **four kinds of calculation are named one by one**; ⭐⭐ **exact published-grid lookups is a checkable implementation choice**, ⭐ **since it interpolates nothing and reads the official grid instead**; **and ⭐⭐ the semantics are attributed to the publications**, ⭐ **so the rules of calculation have a citable origin**. **⑤ ⭐⭐ Other details**: **the engineering layering is listed line by line**, row types and configuration, generic loading and saving, database bulk insertion, scenario calculation, a console application and a web interface with a JSON API, **with a separate Python application beside them**; **tests come in two suites**, one on each language, **with the database integration tests stated verbatim to run always in continuous integration and to need a container runtime locally**, ⭐ **so dependencies are graded**; **dependency versions are given one by one**; **and build and test commands are listed**. **⑥ ⭐⭐ Readable with** [[mortsoa]], [[mortalitytables]], [[human-mortality-db]], [[soa-practice-tools]] and [[ifoa-formulae-tables]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️⚠️ Three signals agree that there is no licence statement**: **the GitHub licence field is NONE**, **neither a licence file nor a licence markdown file exists at the root of the default branch, both raw probes returning 404**, **and its documentation file returns no hit for licence, copyright or the copyright sign** — ⭐ **and this matters especially here, because the repository commits the official tables alongside the code, so rights in the code and the terms for redistributing those official files are two different things**, ⚠️ **with no official terms examined**. **② ⚠️⚠️⚠️ Nothing in it was run** — **no software development kit or Python dependency installed, no build, test or extraction script run, no extracted, processed or generated file regenerated, its factor command and web interface not run, and none of its official spreadsheets opened**; **so this entry does not claim its extraction, verification, conversion or factor calculation works as described**, ⭐ **what it verified being the verbatim documentation file, the file listing and directory structure measured through the trees endpoint, and the existence and names of the official spreadsheet files**. **③ ⚠️⚠️ Neither its source nor the two notes under its documentation directory were read**, ⭐ **so how the value-by-value verification is implemented, whether the lookups really are exact, and whether the database tests really always run were not checked** — ⭐ **the single most important thing to verify next for this entry**. **④ ⭐ ⚠️ One naming note is recorded plainly**: **its documentation file uses a mixed-case name**, ⭐ **so probing for the conventional name misses it**, ⚠️ **with no judgement offered on its contents**. **⑤ ⚠️ Whether its extracted results match the official PDFs was not verified**, ⭐ **the value-by-value claim resting on the repository’s own word and not re-checked here**. **⑥ ⭐ ⚠️ No claim is made that its factors are usable for any actual filing or valuation**, ⭐ **the origin of the calculation rules being official publications, none of whose rules were checked here**. **⑦ ⚠️ It was created on 2022-04-13 and last pushed on 2026-09-09**, ⭐ **selection resting on the push falling inside the window**. **⑧ ⚠️ This entry records what was seen on 2026-09-11**. **Verification note**: the repository was read on 2026-09-11 through the repository search endpoint and the GitHub API for stars, licence field, language, size and dates; **its documentation file was read via `raw.githubusercontent.com` and checked verbatim, noting that the file name is not in the conventional all-capitals form**; licence file probes against the root returned 404; **the file listing was read through the trees endpoint, 239 files, against which the presence of the source, test, database, source-data, processed-data, generated-data, documentation and workflow paths and the file names of the official spreadsheets were checked**; **nothing was cloned, no dependency was installed, no script or test was run, no file was regenerated, no spreadsheet or PDF was opened, and no other network observation was made**.
